Discussed how the East India Company changed from a trading company to a ruling power.
Reviewed Indian cotton being used for goods made in England.
Practised the Company’s use of armies, forts, battles, and revenue collection.

Child requested a game and a short break; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the Company’s shift from trade to political control, including forts, armies, Plassey, and Buxar. Zoya recalled several key details, including the three sides at Buxar; no mix-up was recorded for later correction. They also took a short break after saying they felt a little tired.
